name: smwmusic-plok-cotton-island
title: Plok - Cotton Island
description:
Cotton Island from Plok.

If anyone is not the biggest fan of how Plok's instruments are tuned about a quartertone higher than the conventional tuning, add "$EE$C0 h-1" next to every channel in the .txt file. Channels are marked with #0, #1, #2... etc.

UPDATE: The kick drum will no longer click in SNES emulators (the pitch value must be exactly 05FE), and fixed the bass trombone notes in the middle of the song.
